intro.text: A town with a large population but only one lawkeeper, Jon Deadfinger, who worked alongside Miles Dagouter and Waxillium Ladrian.
A city in the northern Roughs, north of Faradana and east of True Madil. For all its many people, it had just one lawkeeper, Jon Deadfinger, a partner of Miles Dagouter and Waxillium Ladrian.

items.text: Jon once had Wayne set to hang here for a murder Wayne had committed.
